messages:
Jordan: kicking off onboarding for TempestNeo-13B (open-checkpoint). Need perf intake + quant smoke + ctx-length sweep. Goal: decide whether it meets Dedicated latency targets and whether PTQ is acceptable or we need QAT. Punting to eng-ml for prioritization.

Priya: P2 priority from product side (want Dedicated-ready next sprint). What are target SLAs?

Jordan: target p50 <= 60ms for single-token steady-state at batch=1, ctx=512 on A100-80. Throughput targets: ~100 qps at batch=1 for typical short prompts. If int8 gives >10% latency regress or quality regression, escalate.

Sam: I can run batching + ctx sweeps tomorrow on our dedicated perf pool. Need confirmed eval prompt sets and quant configs. Tentative command I'll run:

```
./run_bench --model tempestneo-13b \
  --batch_sizes 1,2,4,8 \
  --ctx_lengths 128,512,1024,2048 \
  --quant_configs none,ptq_int8,ptq_int4 \
  --warmup_steps 200 --measure p50,p90,qps
```

Sam: I'll also do a small steady-state KV-cache test (multi-turn) to measure token-level p99.

bench-bot: queued bench job 7782 for tempestneo-13b (owner: Sam). ETA ~3h. :gear:

Lina: I will own quant experiments. Plan: start with symmetric PTQ (per-tensor) then per-channel if we see quality loss. Eval metrics: perplexity on eval set + rouge/bertscore on synthesis prompts and targeted instruction suite. Eval set: s3://redwood-evals/tempestneo-onboard-v1 (1000 prompts). If PTQ fails, try QAT on a 1e-5lr fine-tune of 1 epoch.

Jordan: quick onboarding checklist (status):
- model artifact in catalog: todo
- baseline fp16 perf (hosted/dedicated): in-progress (Sam)
- int8 PTQ sweep: todo (Lina)
- eval quality baseline (ppl + instr-suite): todo (Lina)
- rollout gating thresholds defined: todo (Jordan/Priya)
- infra reservation for long runs: todo (InfraOncall)
- quick smoke for generation regressions: todo (Sam + Lina)

InfraOncall: can reserve 1x A100-80GB for Tue 10:00-13:00 PT, or we can burst on shared pool tonight if lower priority. Need confirmed window.

Priya: prefer Tue window. Jordan, confirm and we'll lock it. Also mark as P2 in the sprint board.

Sam: small note — earlier Tempest family models showed ~5-9% latency improvement with our optimized kernels at batch=4, but int8 sometimes reduces throughput at large ctx due to kernel fragmentation. Will report breakdown per ctx.

bench-bot: partial results (preliminary, first 30m):
```
BATCH | CTX  | QUANT | QPS  | P50(ms)
----- | ---- | ----- | ---- | -------
1     | 512  | fp16  | 110  | 54
1     | 512  | int8  | 125  | 62
4     | 512  | fp16  | 420  | 60
4     | 512  | int8  | 470  | 56
8     | 2048 | int8  | 150  | 210
```

Lina: interesting — int8 qps up at small ctx/batch but p50 regressed at batch=1/ctx=512. Might be due to extra dequant overhead on single-token step. Will run microtrace to verify. Also will run eval quality pass on job 7782 outputs.

Jordan: OK good catch. Action items:
- @Sam: complete full sweep and upload raw traces + perf profiles to /tmp/perf/tempestneo-2193 by EOD tomorrow.
- @Lina: run eval suite on FP16 and PTQ int8 outputs, report perplexity delta and instruction-suite pass rates.
- @Priya: add rollout gating numbers to the ticket (acceptable delta thresholds).
- @InfraOncall: reserve Tue slot and confirm.

Priya: noted, will add gating: p50 delta <= +10% vs fp16, rouge/bertscore deltas within 2 points absolute, and no >1% of prompts catastrophic decode failures.

Sam: will also attach kernel-level flame graphs to help perf-engineers. Expect final summary in thread. :eyes: 

bench-bot: job 7782 finished (summary attached). Full logs: s3://redwood-bench/tempestneo/7782/logs.tar.gz

Jordan: thanks all. We'll reconvene here after full eval. If PTQ quality looks bad, Lina to try per-channel PTQ then QAT. Next update by 2026-03-25 17:00 PT. :calendar:
